name: Karnataka

demographics.note: All demographic values are Census 2011. literacyRate is stored as a fraction for state files (district files store percent) — literacyRatePercent is provided to avoid ambiguity. population_2026_projected is a projection, not a census count, and its derivation is not documented in this repo.

economy.perCapitaIncomeBasis: Per capita NSDP at current prices (Economic Survey of Karnataka)
economy.gsdpCompositionNote: Broad sectoral GVA shares at state level from the MoSPI/StatisticsTimes compilation. Not to be applied to individual districts — Karnataka DES does not publish district-level sector shares.

hdiNote: Global Data Lab Subnational HDI (2022). Karnataka's own State Human Development Report 2022 reports a state HDI of 0.644 using a different methodology, with Bengaluru Urban highest at 0.738. District-level HDI values in this repo come from the Karnataka SHDR 2022 and are therefore NOT directly comparable to this GDL figure.

dataSources.name: Economic Survey of Karnataka 2024-25 (DES Karnataka)
fields: Per Capita Income (per capita NSDP, current prices)

perCapitaIncome: 376,402 -> 339,813. The old value matched neither Karnataka's 2023-24 PCI (Rs 3,39,813) nor its 2024-25 PCI (Rs 3,80,906), and appears to have conflated vintages or mixed per capita GSDP with per capita income.
